title: nourishing croatian cheese pasta
description: a warm, comforting dish perfect for a sick day or a cozy evening in, featuring the tangy flavors of horseradish and a satisfying cheese pull.
instructions: melt 2 tbsp of butter in a large skillet over medium heat.
add 2 tbsp of horseradish and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add 1/4 cup of bonito flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pappardelle according to package instructions.
in a medium saucepan, melt 2 tbsp of butter over medium heat.
add 2 tbsp of flour and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
slowly add 1 cup of whole milk, whisking constantly.
bring mixture to a simmer and cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring occasionally.
remove from heat and stir in shredded gouda cheese until melted and smooth.
drain cooked pappardelle and add to cheese sauce, tossing to coat.
season with salt, pepper, and garlic powder to taste.
transfer pasta to a serving dish and top with additional grated gouda cheese and a sprinkle of parsley.
serve immediately, garnished with additional parsley and a side of crusty bread if desired.
